review.notes: Full review of a revision that adds section 4.3 (Pagano's mass formula) and one Lean theorem. Sample: 1.2, 2.6, 2.7, 3.3, 3.6, 4.1, 4.3, 5.2, 5.3, 6.2, 6.5, 6.6, 6.7, 7.2, 7.3, each checked against its source at the locator (Pagano arXiv v1, Heiermann MPIM preprint, Greve-Pauli author preprint, Pauli-Roblot HAL, Monge arXiv x2, Jones-Roberts author copy, seven LMFDB knowls) or recomputed. Two P2 findings in 4.3: the fibre of filtOrd over the empty jump set is not open; the records of a path with non-increasing positions do not form a jump set. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry the only warning (19); one-tactic probe closes none of the 19 theorems; the new theorem's elaborated type keeps every binder. Revision audit: no layer or item removed. Not obtained: Deligne, Serre Local Fields, Krasner 1966, Ore 1928, Fried 1974, Serre 1978; knowl lf.means behind a browser check.
